comment: E2E (CHANGELOG 2026-09 section 195): the model learns "$attachment_url:<document_id>" from the attachments prelude only when the host's storage issues read URLs. The prompt asks for a link without naming the placeholder. Echo on 127.0.0.1:8766. With COLMENA_LOCAL=true the echo receives a link and downloads the 80 bytes, and send_image's result shows the placeholder. With in-memory storage the model is not taught the form and the echo receives no link.

config.system_message: You send files to an image service with the send_image tool.
config.prompt: Send the attached image to the image service with send_image. The service downloads the image from a link you put in image_url; it does not accept the image's content. Then reply with the tool's raw result.

send_image.name: send_image
send_image.description: Queues an image job on the image service.

image_url.description: A link the service downloads the image from.
